name: Keepers 2: Shattered Realms
source:
Struggling to meet the expectations people have of the new princess, she finally gets old enough to go to school to become a keeper. On her adventure she'll eventually uncover secrets which even the former queen was unable to figure out, not knowing, that everything is against her from the very moment she was born.

A lot of new and old faces await you. Will they change the princess or not...

Meanwhile - in a very distant and foreign realm - a cow girl without any memories about her past begins her journey, not knowing that people are after her...

translation:
她努力满足人们对新公主的期望，终于到了可以入学、接受守护者训练的年纪。在冒险中，她将逐渐揭开连前任女王也未能解明的秘密，却不知道，从出生的那一刻起，一切就都与她为敌。

许多新面孔与老面孔正等待着你。他们会改变公主吗……

与此同时，在一个遥远而陌生的领域，一个失去全部过往记忆的牛娘，也踏上了旅程，浑然不知有人正在追捕自己……
